title: Tropical Watersports – Jet Ski Rentals
specs: Premium watercraft including supercharged RXP-X Performance model
Locations in Jacksonville and St. Augustine
Operators must meet Florida's minimum age requirement to operate a personal watercraft
Valid government-issued photo ID required from every operator at check-in
Rental agreement and liability waiver required before launch
Operators born on or after January 1, 1988 must carry a boating safety ID card or temporary certificate
One operator plus one passenger per watercraft
Each watercraft accommodates one operator and one passenger

options.name: Regular Jet Ski

options.name: RXP-X Performance
options.detail: High-performance Sea-Doo with stronger acceleration and sport handling. Limited availability.

blurb: Guests rent jet skis to ride on open Florida water with a local crew. They can choose between a comfortable regular jet ski or a supercharged RXP-X Performance model. The experience includes a safety briefing before launch.
extraNote: Passengers for rentals under 2 hours pay $15 extra per watercraft carrying a passenger; for rentals 2 hours or longer, passengers ride at no additional charge · Arrive on time for safety briefing before launch · Confirmed meeting point at Jacksonville or St. Augustine launch locations
